_comment: Corpus settings for run_corpus.py (mcx7). Setups are found by alamo_mod_check --list-mods; this file only names
display names, the map / campaign picks of the reference set (docs/MODS.md 'Reference set'; legacy docs/MODS.md 10.4) and accepted blockers.
An entry applies to every setup whose resolved stack contains that mod (a parent's settings reach its submods);
the setup's own entry wins. Keys: name, reference, space_map, land_map, campaign, skirmish_args (extra
alamo_headless arguments of the skirmish runs), galactic_args, smoke_env ({VAR: value} for the smokes), blockers (the
last recorded sweep's open blockers, a note the runner does not read), accept
([{blocker: regex, why, ref}]: an explained, retail-equivalent or by-design blocker that does not lower the grade).

1976399102.name: Fall of the Republic
blockers: 2026-11-27 (#699): G2; the runs pass (0 Lua errors, 4-worker equal) and smoke_skirmish 86 of 86

smoke_campaign stops at step 27 of 110 ('paused' after the pause key): the campaign-start IDD_NEUTRALIZE_HERO_DIALOG stays open (the holoscript's own 'paused' step timed out on it too) and the session does not pause under it; UI smoke flow, routed to the UI lane
the static honour gaps (#77 tag-ledger tickets)

accept.why: the sandbox starts every player at AI_Player_Control None; the GC master script switches the AI on only after the human answers its HISTORICAL_GC_CHOICE popup, which a headless AI-only run never does

2858787558.name: Star Wars: Age of Legends
blockers: 2026-11-27 (#701): G2; land 0 Lua errors, space 5 (all the Try_Weapon_Switch nil call, accepted); 4-worker runs equal
smoke_skirmish runs 86 of 86 but fails the attract-demo orientation check: 24 moving hulls, 0 nose-first, 18 sideways (mean cos 0.109); UI/render smoke flow, routed to the UI lane

the mod's Data/Scripts/AI/SpaceMode/BuildStructureSpace.lua starts with a UTF-8 BOM and does not compile, a tactical AI script error outside the Lua error count (docs/MODS.md: retail's Lua does not skip a BOM either): a mod-data fault, not a port blocker

the static honour gaps (#77 tag-ledger tickets)

accept.why: the mod's own Data/Scripts/Library/PGCommands.lua shadows FoC's and defines only Try_Weapon_Switch_Ground, while its BusyTacticalFreeStore.lua and PGEvents.lua still call Try_Weapon_Switch: retail resolves require('pgcommands') to the same mod file and raises the same nil-call error

every space-run Lua error is BusyTacticalFreeStore.lua:186's call of Try_Weapon_Switch (a nil value): the mod's PGCommands.lua shadows FoC's without defining it, as for the land entry above, and retail raises the same nil-call error

2498889654:sub.name: Infinite Unit Cap for Thrawn's Revenge (2498889654)
blockers: 2026-11-26 G1: galactic: no AI orders on Thrawn_Empire (the AI idle blocker, #694)

accept.why: the submod is built for another Thrawn's Revenge version: its 52 Units XML files replace TR's with another roster (its Units_Corvettes.xml has no CR90, its Units_Frigates.xml no Acclamator_I_Assault or Bothan_Assault_Cruiser), so the load reports 3798 unresolved variants and the GC story's ENABLE_BUILDABLE calls name unknown types. The story stalls (173 events against 1220 on TR alone) before TR's options-handler plugin switches the factions to their AI (StoryUtil.ChangeAIPlayer, SWITCH_CONTROL at frame 279 on TR alone), so every AI player stays None. A mod-data mismatch, not an engine gap
